title: limnophila heterophylla var. reflexa
intro: Limnophila heterophylla var. reflexa, commonly known as "Australian Mint Bush" or "Australian Ginger", is a plant species belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Limnophila heterophylla var. reflexa include its potential to reduce fever, relieve coughs, and soothe skin irritations. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
